title: Christmas dinner at The Anchor, until 20 December
preheader: Four or more of you, from £23 a head, and everyone picks their own courses.

data.alt: The Anchor, Stanwell Moor Village, since 1751. Holly, pine cones and Christmas greenery around the wordmark.

image.alt: A Christmas dinner at The Anchor: roast beef, a Yorkshire pudding, pigs in blankets, stuffing, roast potatoes, mash, peas and sprouts

data.heading: Your Christmas table's waiting
body: Christmas dinner is on now at The Anchor, and the last sitting is Sunday 20 December. It's for four or more of you. Book the table first. Then we email you a link, and each of you picks 1, 2 or 3 courses and tells us about any allergies. Choices close at noon, 7 days before your booking.
It's from £23 a head. Go for 2 or 3 courses and there's a glass of prosecco in it for the adults, or an orange juice if you'd rather.
There's a £10 per person deposit when you book, and it comes off your bill. Sittings run Tuesday to Saturday, plus Sundays from 1pm to 6pm.
Book online at least 8 days ahead. Booking for more than 26, or less than 8 days away? Call us on 01753 682707 and we'll book it for you.
